prompt:
Return ONLY a single JSON object (no markdown fence, no prose) with EXACTLY these 5 keys and values:
1. "id": the result of (19 times 4) plus 29 — as a number, not a string
2. "name": the word "velvet" spelled BACKWARDS, all lowercase
3. "tags": exactly these 6 strings sorted in alphabetical (A to Z) order: "ember", "flint", "alpha", "cedar", "delta", "brick"
4. "active": the boolean true (not a string)
5. "meta": a nested object with exactly two keys — "len": the number of letters in "velvet" (as a number), and "even": a boolean saying whether the value of "id" is an even number
Any extra key, wrong type, wrong order inside "tags", wrong nesting, or wrong casing counts as a mistake.
